MET |
| SIG-RQ-004 (owner) | the queue is paginated at ≤50 cards and ≤150 KiB per page (K9 §6.1 — `/research-queue/page/<n>/` emits pages 2..N only), with no-JS place/type/role routes and totals that reconcile: `placeFacets`/`facetValues` map every card to exactly one facet per dimension so the rendered counts sum to the lane total (asserted in `queue-hub.test.ts`). The T1 document budget (153 600 B) bounds every queue route wire-side; the hub ships far under it (e2e budget sweep, all routes in-manifest). MET |

| SIG-ENG-042 | cited — an unparseable place rest-path (`type`, `sort`, `page` shapes the family never mints) fails the build (`parseQueuePlacePath` → null → throw); an unknown sort key mints no route; the export's campaign rows without a handle fail loud |

| plan cell decisions | `D-K11-1` (aggregate field-gap campaigns), `D-K11-5` (curation lane stays loopback — the queue_meta note renders verbatim), `D-K11-6` (claiming = priority, never exclusivity) — carried verbatim |

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/queue-hub.ts` — the RQ-03a page model: `QueueCampaign`/`QueueMeta` wire types, place facets on the card's `place.slug` (K4 display path) covering slug-path children with an honest `unplaced` bucket, one-dimension type/role facets (`ROLE_LABELS` = the plain-language "File a records request" names), the `nestedTypeFacets` >50-task rule for `place/…/type/<t>/`, the three K11 §4.2 sorts (`priority` = `orderQueue`, `newest` = `generated_at` desc, `oldest` = stale-evidence-first with undated tasks last), ≤50-card pagination, the rest-param parser (`<slug>[/type/<t>][/sort/<k>][/page/<n>]`, fail-closed on unminted shapes), route-href helpers, `PATH_SEP` (built separator — no `"/"` literal site).
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getQueueMeta()` (export: `web/analytics/queue_meta.json`; fixtures: the same shape computed from the committed queue — never a second counting path) and `getQueueCampaigns()` (export: the `web/tasks/campaign/*.jsonl.gz` shards, gzip-decoded, a missing dir = the honest no-campaigns state; fixtures: `QUEUE_CAMPAIGNS`).
- Fixtures — every `RESEARCH_QUEUE` card gains the v2 fields (K11 §3 `T-<place>-…-<hash>` handle, `title`, `place`/`place_basis`, `lane`, `predicate_ids`, `status`, `generated_at`, `detector_version`), incl. one `unplaced` card; `QUEUE_CAMPAIGNS` — one `M-…` `sig.queue-campaign/1` row with a member sample. `build-fixture-export.ts` emits the campaign shards + the populated `queue_meta` lanes/shard index, so `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` builds see the real v2 shape.
- Routes (all T1 zero-JS): `/research-queue/` hub (intro + no-leaderboard note + how-to-help strip + start-here entries + queue order's first ≤50 cards + campaign lane + downloads/shard table + provenance), `/research-queue/page/<n>/`, `/research-queue/sort/<newest|oldest>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`), `/research-queue/type/<task_type>/` and `/research-queue/role/<assignee_class>/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`, `…/sort/<k>/`, `…/sort/<k>/page/<n>/`), `/research-queue/place/<slug>/` covering the place AND its slug-path children (+ `…/page/<n>/`, `…/sort/<k>/`, and `…/type/<t>/` minted only above `PLACE_TYPE_THRESHOLD`), `/research-queue/campaigns/` (+ `…/page/<n>/`). The old single-page `research-queue.astro` is replaced; `page-types.ts` owner → P36.61.
- Components — `QueueCard.astro` (title, handle, subject link, closing condition, evidence sought, type/place/role facet links, assignee + plain-language role label, effort, scope, status, named missing predicates, trigger + evidence date, claim state with "priority, not exclusivity", full disposition vocabulary), `QueueCampaignCard.astro` (handle, field, subject class, place, member count, kind, member sample — never a `/campaign/<handle>/` link P36.62 has not minted).
- Links in (SIG-UI-079): `WhatWeDontKnow.astro` renders a queue link in both variants on every dossier; the home `ENTRY_POINTS` grid gains the queue start-here card.
- Copy — batch-01 RQ-02…RQ-07 (hub how-to-help/start-here/campaigns/downloads sentences, the home entry-point body, the gaps-section queue link) sha256-pinned `pending`; `test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` `ASTRO_PAGES` gains `/research-queue/` → `research-queue/index.astro`.
- Tests — `tests/unit/queue-hub.test.ts` (14 legs: facet totals reconcile, parent-covering, children listing, unplaced fallback, disjoint-covering type/role sets, the >50 nested rule, the three sorts + undated-last, ≤50 pagination, the rest-param parser incl. fail-closed, campaign contract fields, href builders); `tests/e2e/research-queue.spec.ts` (hub strips + sort nav, campaign row + list, card fields + facet links + no `/task/` dead link, the three facet routes, unplaced bucket, sort ordering, the three SIG-UI-079 link-in legs); `corrections-methodology.spec.ts` updated for the facet-route geography test (the in-page jurisdiction anchors became real place routes); `chrome.spec.ts` K14 NEW-8 sweep gains `test.setTimeout(120_000)` (the ~60-route family outgrew the default budget — the same bound `budget.spec.ts` uses).
